explained.hub.title: How 6529 works, and how we know.
explained.hub.mission: 6529 is a community that collects CC0 art, {perWeek} Meme cards a week; each whole day you hold a card adds to your Total Days Held (TDH), which weighs the votes on the next card.
explained.hub.station.artSay: Every {days} a new card is minted, CC0, about {copies} copies.
explained.hub.station.holdSay: Copies sit in wallets. Up to four wallets count as one identity.
explained.hub.station.timeSay: Each whole day held adds a card's rate to TDH: {total} for everyone in the result of {date}.
explained.hub.station.standingSay: Your TDH plus your xTDH sets how much Rep and NIC (Network Identity Check) you can give, and both count toward your Level with the Rep you receive. xTDH is a separate score, never TDH: what other holders grant you, and what your own cards produce that you have not granted away.
explained.hub.station.decideSay: Main Stage weighs votes by TDH and picks a card {perWeek} times a week.
explained.hub.station.executeSay: Today 6529's admin keys mint the winner. Network execution is decided, not built.
explained.hub.chapterComing: Explained in {title}, a chapter still coming.

explained.hub.check.identitiesBody: identities: 6529.io's TDH equals two separately written recomputations, in each of the {days} results since {first}.
explained.hub.check.identitiesSome: identities: 6529.io's TDH equals two separately written recomputations today, and in {equal} of the {days} results since {first}.
explained.hub.check.theoremsBody: about a Lean model of the rules: {tdh} on TDH's, {p53} on the validators' (P53, a proposal). {shownFalse} earlier statements were shown false and stay on record. The model's source is private, so for now only 6529 can rerun the proofs; the manifest names its commit, {commit}.
explained.hub.check.proofBody: proved in zero knowledge: the cycle dated {day}, under the retired {version} rules. Mainnet's SP1 verifier accepts proof A in a read-only call, with nothing written to Ethereum. Proof B of that day is not done; under TDH v1.4, both proofs exist only for a synthetic test cycle.
explained.hub.check.proofWhen: Proof A {date}; proof B not yet
explained.hub.check.candour: Anyone can check each day's file against the index and add up 6529.io's signed upload. Recomputing a day needs the validator code, private for now (D116).

explained.hub.cc0.label: CC0, in one minute
explained.hub.cc0.title: The art is free. Holding is what counts.
explained.hub.cc0.body: The Memes are dedicated to the public domain under CC0, Creative Commons' “No Rights Reserved” tool: anyone, owner or not, may copy, remix and sell the art without asking. Owning a card gives no exclusive rights to its image. What holding gives you is TDH, while you hold it.
explained.hub.cc0.keep: For the artist: you make the dedication when your card is released, and it cannot be withdrawn. No one has to credit you, but you stay the card's credited artist on 6529.io, and you can use your own image like anyone else. The CC0 deed asks users not to suggest you endorse what they make.
explained.hub.cc0.limit: CC0 releases only the artist's own rights: Meme Card #1 shows a CryptoPunk, whose copyright was never the artist's to give, so CC0 does not cover the Punk itself.
